description: Propose durations for a saved program from its recorded runs: median as the default, P10 to P90 as the range, never narrower than the author's, with the evidence per step and the effect on total length. Saves nothing: pass `accept` to get the calibrated program, then save_program. Needs the user's Rhylthyme account.

accept.description: Step ids to accept, or "all": also returns the calibrated program. Nothing is saved either way.

history.description: Run records to use instead of the stored ones.

k.description: Measurements a step needs for a proposal (default 5).

program.description: Program JSON to calibrate; omit to use program_id's saved JSON.

program_id.description: Saved program UUID whose recorded runs are the evidence.

since.description: Only runs started on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO).

token.description: Access token from the login tool. Omit when the account is connected.

name: calibrate_program
title: Propose durations from recorded runs
